remarks: Welcome to your new haven in vibrant SONO-where modern design meets convenience! This freshly updated property is a dream come true, perfect for anyone seeking that urban lifestyle with a touch of tranquility. Step inside to experience the open layout that feels both expansive and cozy. With central AC and polished hardwood floors running seamlessly throughout, comfort and style come standard. The living space is naturally lit, thanks to large, elegant windows, complemented by sleek recessed lighting. The heart of this home-the kitchen-is a contemporary chef's delight with its U-shaped design. It boasts state-of-the-art, stainless-steel appliances, including a sought-after wine fridge. Imagine whipping up meals or entertaining friends here while enjoying the beautiful subway tile backsplash. And don't miss the convenience of in-unit laundry, hidden discreetly behind stylish louvered doors. The community is pet-friendly, adding to the welcoming vibe. Plus, you're just a stroll away from the Norwalk train, making commutes a breeze!
